int add(int a, int b) {
    return a + b;
}

int main() {
    printf("%d", add(3, 4));
}

ret

_add:

    mov ebp, esp
    sub esp, 8      ; stack for locals
    mov eax, [ebp + 8]
    mov [ebp-4], eax
    mov eax, [ebp + 12]
    mov [ebp-8], eax
    mov eax, [ebp-4]
    push eax
    mov eax, [ebp-8]
    pop ebx
    add eax, ebx
    mov esp, ebp
    pop ebp
    ret
    mov esp, ebp
    pop ebp
    ret

_main:

    mov ebp, esp

    push eax
    mov eax, 3
    push eax
    call _add
    add esp, 8
    push eax
    jmp .L1_strend
